hypertagmeme.translation: 超语法单位, 超法位

hypertensin.definition: n any of several vasoconstrictor substances (trade name Hypertensin) that cause narrowing of blood vessels

hypertension.definition: n a common disorder in which blood pressure remains abnormally high (a reading of 140/90 mm Hg or greater)
hypertension.translation:
n. 高血压, 过度紧张
[医] 高血压, 血压过高, 张力过强, 压力过高

hypertension activator.translation: [医] 高血压激活质(血管紧张素原的旧名)

hypertensive.definition:
n. a person who has abnormally high blood pressure
a. having abnormally high blood pressure
hypertensive.translation:
a. 高血压的
n. 高血压

hypertensive neuroretinopathy.translation: [医] 高血压性视神经[视]网膜病

hypertensives.definition:
plural of hypertensive
n. a person who has abnormally high blood pressure
a. having abnormally high blood pressure
hypertensives.translation:
(hypertensive 的复数) a. 高血压的
n. 高血压

hypertext.definition: n. machine-readable text that is not sequential but is organized so that related items of information are connected

hypertexts.definition:
plural of hypertext
n. machine-readable text that is not sequential but is organized so that related items of information are connected
hypertexts.translation: (hypertext 的复数) [计] 超文本系统

hyperthermal.definition: a of or relating to or affected by hyperthermia

hyperthermia.definition: n. abnormally high body temperature; sometimes induced (as in treating some forms of cancer)
hyperthermia.translation:
[化] 过热
[医] 高温, 热

hyperthermocouple.translation: 超热热电偶; 超温差电偶

hyperthermy.definition: n abnormally high body temperature; sometimes induced (as in treating some forms of cancer)

hyperthymergasia.translation: 情感过盛, 情感活泼

hyperthymia.translation: n. 情感增盛, 心情激越

hyperthyroid.translation:
a. 甲状腺机能亢进的
n. 甲状腺机能亢进患者

hyperthyroidism.translation:
n. 甲状腺功能亢进症
[医] 甲状腺机能亢进

hypertonia.definition: n (of muscular tissue) the state of being hypertonic

hypertonic.definition:
a. (of living tissue) in a state of abnormally high tension
a. (of a solution) having a higher osmotic pressure than a comparison solution
hypertonic.translation:
a. 高渗的
[医] 高张的, 高渗的

hypertonicity.definition:
n (of a solution) the extent to which a solution has a higher osmotic pressure than some other
n (of muscular tissue) the state of being hypertonic

hypertonus.definition: n (of muscular tissue) the state of being hypertonic

hypertoxicity.translation:
n. 剧毒, 剧毒性

hypertron.translation: 超小型电子射线加速器

hypertrophic.translation:
a. 肥大的, 过度膨胀的, 肥厚的
[医] 肥大的

hypertrophy.definition:
n. abnormal enlargement of a body part or organ

n. 肥大, 过度增大, 过度膨胀
[医] 肥大
